ideas.children_he: הַגֶּשֶׁם פָּסַק וְהַמַּיִם יָרְדוּ לְאַט. גַּם אַחֲרֵי תְּקוּפָה קָשָׁה, הַשִּׁנּוּי לְטוֹבָה יָכוֹל לָבוֹא בְּהַדְרָגָה.
ideas.children_en: The flood lasted a long time; rain stopped and waters lessened. The ark moved and rested on Mount Ararat. Slowly, the mountain tops became visible as waters went down.

ideas.children_he: נֹחַ שָׁלַח צִפֳּרִים כְּדֵי לִבְדֹּק אִם יֵשׁ יַבָּשָׁה. כְּשֶׁאֲנַחְנוּ לֹא יוֹדְעִים מָה קוֹרֶה, כְּדַאי לִבְדֹּק וְלֹא לְנַחֵשׁ.
ideas.children_en: Noah opened the ark's window and sent a raven and dove to check if water was gone. Both birds came back because no dry place was found.

ideas.children_he: הַיּוֹנָה חָזְרָה עִם עֲלֵה זַיִת. סִימָן קָטָן יָכוֹל לָתֵת תִּקְוָה גְּדוֹלָה.
ideas.children_en: Noah waited and sent the dove again. The dove brought an olive leaf and later did not return because it found dry land to rest on.

ideas.children_he: נֹחַ רָאָה שֶׁהַמַּיִם יָרְדוּ, אֲבָל הִמְתִּין עַד שֶׁהָאֲדָמָה הִתְיַבְּשָׁה. לִפְעָמִים סַבְלָנוּת הִיא הַבְּחִירָה הַחֲכָמָה.
ideas.children_en: Noah opened the ark's roof and saw the water was gone but the ground was still muddy. After some time, the land dried enough to walk on.

ideas.children_he: אֱלֹהִים אָמַר לְנֹחַ לָצֵאת מִן הַתֵּבָה. אַחֲרֵי זְמַן רַב שֶׁל פַּחַד, הִגִּיעַ הַזְּמַן לְהַתְחָלָה חֲדָשָׁה.
ideas.children_en: God told Noah to leave the ark with his family and all animals. The animals had been weak or asleep, and now they would multiply on the land.

ideas.children_he: נֹחַ וּמִשְׁפַּחְתּוֹ יָצְאוּ עִם בַּעֲלֵי הַחַיִּים. כְּשֶׁמַּתְחִילִים מֵחָדָשׁ, אֶפְשָׁר לִבְנוֹת עוֹלָם טוֹב יוֹתֵר.
ideas.children_en: Noah and his family left the ark with all the animals, each according to family, to start life anew on the earth.

ideas.children_he: נֹחַ הוֹדָה לֵאלֹהִים עַל הַהַצָּלָה. גַּם אֲנַחְנוּ יְכוֹלִים לַעֲצֹר וּלְהַגִּיד תּוֹדָה עַל הַדְּבָרִים הַטּוֹבִים.
ideas.children_en: Noah built an altar and offered sacrifices from clean animals and birds to thank God.

ideas.children_he: אֱלֹהִים הִבְטִיחַ שֶׁסֵּדֶר הָעוֹנוֹת יִמָּשֵׁךְ. אַחֲרֵי סְעָרָה גְּדוֹלָה, הָעוֹלָם יָכוֹל לַחֲזֹר לְסֵדֶר וּלְצַמֵּחַ תִּקְוָה.
ideas.children_en: God chose not to destroy all life again by flood, because people have bad desires. He set new times and seasons that continue even now.
